title: rosa canina var. attenuata
intro: Rosa canina var. attenuata, commonly known as Dwarf Dog Rose or Dwarf Wild Rose, is a deciduous shrub that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant is rich in health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help protect against various health conditions such as cardiovascular diseases, cancer, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. attenuata include anti-oxidative, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which can help in wound healing, reducing inflammation, and improving immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
